evidence: Read instruction.md cold. It is continuous first-person prose opening with a request ('Can you build HireOps into a compensation change desk?', instruction.md:1) and motivating needs by the people involved ('so we can explain a change to an auditor', :5; 'The change desk is somewhere we work, not just a form we submit', :7). None of the defect forms in quality-checks.md:11 is present: no numbered acceptance list, no bullets, no shall/must table, no feature matrix, no file layout or endpoint list. Line 15 names Node.js/Express/SQLite, the start command, port and GET /api/health, but that is the runtime contract required by row 4 and it explicitly leaves the rest open ('How you lay the other files and routes out under /app is your call'); detailed financial rules are delegated to /instructions/hireops_rules.md (:13) rather than recited. The app is a product ask, not a build recipe. Weaknesses, real but bounded: (a) instruction.md:13 from 'Finance's coordinated changes need an ordinary form...' onward is five unrelated requirements in a row with no connecting motivation, switching from 'we/I' to third person ('A failed rescission request must retain its effective date for retry.') - it reads as an unbulleted acceptance checklist appended after review rounds; (b) instruction.md:17 is six clipped spec sentences ('Start with no shipped database, seed once, and retain new work on later restarts.'); (c) instruction.md:9 packs a timing bound and three conditions into one sentence ('Within fifteen seconds ... with no reload and no click'); (d) at 816 words with eight 'must/mustn't' statements the brief is dense for a spoken request. These lower naturalness without turning the document into a spec sheet. Broken-app/conforming-alternative probes do not apply to this row: it judges the wording of the brief, not app behaviour. Not verified by me: the aggregate input_sha256 (I hashed instruction.md and the workbook only). Hosted QC outcome for this row is unmeasured.
suggested_fix: Optional: fold the tail of instruction.md:13 into the paragraphs that already cover those topics, in the requester's own voice (e.g. put the kept-entries-after-refusal and rescission-date sentences beside the 'tell me which hire and which field' sentence on line 7), and soften line 17 into two or three connected sentences. No requirement needs to be added or removed.
